description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and India for the supply of new 100 Ambulances to the 1990 Suwaseriya National Emergency Ambulance Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The '1990 Suwaseriya National Emergency Ambulance Service' was launched in 2016 with the support of a Financial Grant from the Government of India and was expanded island-wide in the year 2018. The said Service provides a free 24‑hour service covering all Districts and handles between 1,000 - 1,200 patient transport requests daily. These Ambulances run approximately 9 million kilometers annually, thereby increasing the likelihood of mechanical breakdowns arising within the current fleet of 322 Ambulances. The Government of India has agreed to provide a Financial Grant, enabling to procure 100 new, fully medically equipped ambulances for use by the 1990 Suwaseriya Service, taking into account a special request made by the Government of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of India for the purpose of obtaining the said Financial Grant, was approved by the Cabinet.
